function: Refined channel estimation within an iterative joint channel estimation, detection and decoding receiver for superimposed pilots in uplink MIMO-OFDM; DL network denoises LS estimates (p. 5-6).
system: Uplink MIMO-OFDM, 2x2 and 64x4 antennas (BS receive x UE transmit), 144 subcarriers, 16-QAM LDPC, 3.5 GHz simulation, 2 GHz OTA; no RIS (p. 7, 13).
method: Residual CNN denoiser with despreading, attention block and DNN interpolator refining LS estimates inside an iterative receiver; supervised MSE training (received-signal loss for OTA) (p. 5-7, 13).
data_channel: Sionna CDL-C of 3GPP TR 38.901, 3.5 GHz; 2.05e5 training samples (2x2), 5.12e4 (64x4); OTA: 4.6e5 USRP samples for training, 1e4 frames for testing (p. 7, 13).
test_conditions: Matched: train and test at 324 km/h; mismatched: train at 72 km/h, test at 324 km/h; OTA models trained on OTA data (p. 9-10, 13).
baselines: Non-learned: orthogonal-pilot LMMSE receivers (1P, 2P, 4P), iterative SIP-IC receiver [24], LMMSE and VMP refinement, perfect-CSI bounds; no earlier learned estimator (p. 7-8, 10).
metrics: BLER, BER and throughput versus SNR (Eq. 31); trainable parameters and per-frame runtime (p. 7-9, 11-12); OTA BLER and throughput (p. 13-15).
complexity: Table II: asymptotic orders for LMMSE, VMP-L, VMP, DL; DL runtime 1.33 ms (2x2) and 6.71 ms (64x4) per frame; 6.87e4 parameters (p. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 7: "clustered delay line (CDL) channel model with the CDL-C power delay profile"
q2_support: p. 10: "trained using samples obtained at a lower speed of v = 72 km/h, allowing us to evaluate the generalization capability"
q3_support: p. 8: "A state-of-the-art iterative SIP receiver is included for comparison"
q5_support: p. 13: "the model is trained on 4.6 × 105 OTA samples collected"
notes: Included, area 2: the only learned element is the DL channel estimator (p. 5-6, loss on channel MSE p. 7); detection, decoding, LMMSE and VMP parts are non-learned, and the reported metrics (BLER, throughput) are those of the whole receiver. q1: simulations use Sionna CDL-C of 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 7, ref. [32] on p. 16) and the DL model is also trained and tested on OTA measurements (p. 13). q3=0: the baselines on p. 7-8 (OP LMMSE receivers, SIP-IC [24], LMMSE, VMP, VMP-L, perfect CSI) are all non-learned, and the ablations on p. 10-11 are variants of the proposed network, so no earlier learned estimator or standard network is compared. q5=1 only through the measured-data clause: the DL estimator is trained and tested on OTA samples collected by the authors (p. 13: 'test dataset comprises OTA samples'); no code or data link or DOI is given, so openness is none; reviewer to confirm.
